tool: scratchpad mutd2: operator/condition enumeration (===/!==, < <= > >=, && ||, true/false, if-negation, +1/-1) applied one at a time through a vite transform plugin; tier 1 = units + synth tests, tier 2 (survivors) = kind + units + synth + the four vector shards

equivalents.reason: copying zero bytes into the destination is a no-op
the second conjunct opos < outLen stops the loop first: after 1023 rounds opos is exactly BLOB_MAX_DATA, which is >= every accepted outLen
reading data[length] yields undefined, which every caller uses only inside bitwise operators where undefined behaves as 0
subarray(length, length+31) is empty and Uint8Array.set(empty) is a no-op: buf31 stays zero
readOffset < data.length stops first for every accepted length (<= BLOB_MAX_DATA, which fills exactly 1024 rounds)
extra rounds after the data is consumed only write zeros into a zero-initialised blob; the output is byte-identical
an entry whose key ends at depth has e.key[depth] undefined, which never equals the nibble, so it is excluded either way
build() groups by filter and finds the common prefix with every(): its result does not depend on the order of the entries, so the sort is only for readability
the values come from a Set (distinct), so the comparator is never asked about two equal values
when equal the assignment spineMax = lim.maxSpineHeaders writes the same value

decodeBody is strict and bijective (unsorted or duplicate nodes, trailing bytes and non-canonical counts are all refused), so encode(decode(x)) == x for every accepted x; the check is a belt-and-braces mirror of the Go Kind.Verify
